name: mcp-over-webquik
description: MCP server for Sberbank webQUIK trading terminal
long_description:
Connect AI assistants to **webQUIK** (webquik.sberbank.ru): portfolio, quotes, orders, and trading.

Each client session is isolated. Call `login` with your broker account number and password, then `submit_pin` if SMS verification is required.

Bundled Sber CA certificates are used for TLS to webQUIK.

ca_bundle.title: Custom CA bundle
ca_bundle.description: Optional PEM file for webQUIK TLS. Leave empty to use bundled Sber CA certificates.

ssl_verify.title: SSL verify
ssl_verify.description: Verify webQUIK TLS certificates. Disable only for local debugging.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Log in to webQUIK with broker account and password

tools.name: submit_pin
tools.description: Submit SMS or PIN code after login

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Log out and remove the session

tools.name: webquik_search_securities
tools.description: Search securities by name or ticker

tools.name: webquik_get_quotes
tools.description: Get order book quotes for a security

tools.name: webquik_send_order
tools.description: Place a limit or market order

prompts.name: webquik_session
prompts.description: Start a webQUIK session and show portfolio
prompts.text: Connect to webQUIK: call login with my broker credentials. If pin_required, ask me for the SMS code and call submit_pin. Then show portfolio summary with webquik_get_portfolio.
